# GeoAlgeria

> The most complete open-source dataset of Algerian administrative divisions. 69 wilayas, 551 dairas, 1,541 communes with postal codes, coordinates, and bilingual names (Arabic/French). Updated for Algeria's 2026 territorial reform (Law 26-06).

## Key Facts

- Algeria has 69 wilayas as of April 2026 (48 original + 10 added in 2019 via Law 19-12 + 11 added in 2026 via Law 26-06)
- 551 dairas and 1,541 communes total
- Each wilaya carries its capital (chef-lieu) as a commune code (`capital_commune_code`), fixed by the decrees that name the chefs-lieux: n° 84-79 (1984) for wilayas 1-48, n° 21-117 (2021) for 49-58, n° 26-206 (2026) for 59-69
- Available as: JSON, CSV, GeoJSON, SQL, npm package (TypeScript)
- Source: Official Algerian government gazette (JORA), Algérie Poste, plus OpenStreetMap for the wilaya boundary polygons and 256 commune centre coordinates
- License: SEE LICENSE IN LICENSE, because the data is under three sets of terms. The compilation is MIT; the wilaya boundary polygons and those 256 commune centre coordinates are ODbL 1.0, (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, and must keep that attribution (see NOTICE); a wilaya's coordinates are the centre of its capital commune, so 6 of the 69 wilaya capital points are among those coordinates (wilayas 7, 16, 25, 32, 52 and 61) and the other 63 wilaya capital points are not OpenStreetMap-derived; the mirrored postal data under data/poste carries Algerie Poste's own terms, Data (c) Algerie Poste; redistributed for reference
- npm: geoalgeria
- GitHub: https://github.com/yasserstudio/geoalgeria

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/yasserstudio/geoalgeria/blob/main/README.md): Full usage guide, API reference, file index
- [Data schema](https://github.com/yasserstudio/geoalgeria/blob/main/data/README.md): Field definitions and types
- [Dataset metadata](https://github.com/yasserstudio/geoalgeria/blob/main/dataset-metadata.json): Schema.org structured data
- [Changelog](https://github.com/yasserstudio/geoalgeria/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): Version history

## Use Cases

- E-commerce address forms and shipping zone configuration
- Database seeding for Algerian apps
- GIS mapping and spatial analysis
- Cascading dropdowns (wilaya > daira > commune)
- Postal code validation and lookup
